attempts.note: Before the measurement the width function and the decision helpers were run on a synthetic image (a bright rectangle on a dark noisy background) and on toy numbers only; no field image was processed.

attempts.outcome: 7,104 frames, all four settings gave a measurement on every frame; 193 s wall with six processes

observations: The measurement time (28 ms per image and setting, single thread) was taken while the GPU training queue of extension_v16 used most CPU cores.
Variant B is the registered primary variant (Table 3 row). Variant A and its unseen-class test are reported as registered; no further variant was computed.
Within-class spread of the session medians (fold 0: SD 16 to 129 mm at the nominal scale) is of the size of, or larger than, the smallest gap between class references (39 to 44 mm over the folds).
